positive_global_styles: instrumental cinematic fantasy score for a premium YouTube countdown of the best fantasy stories
key of D minor, around 88 BPM unless stated otherwise
warm orchestral strings, harp arpeggios, celesta and glockenspiel sparkles, soft french horns, wooden flutes, gentle frame drums
magical, adventurous and full of wonder, elegant and premium, never cheesy
mix leaves plenty of space for a spoken voice-over in the mid range

positive_local_styles: cold open: a quiet library at night, a lone celesta and harp motif from the very first second over soft sustained strings
after eight seconds the music opens up with wonder: rising strings and a warm french horn line
a soft swelling hit in the last two seconds
keeps playing at full energy until the very last second, no ending
